ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic sentence means "I am from Kenya." (1 mark)
   A. اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ
   B. أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ
   C. أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ
   D. أَنَا مِنْ كينيا

2. What does the Arabic word مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) mean? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. How are you? (to a boy)
   C. my name is
   D. hello

3. What does the Arabic word أُخْتٌ (ukht) mean? (1 mark)
   A. father
   B. grandmother
   C. sister
   D. family

4. What does the Arabic word أَبٌ (ab) mean? (1 mark)
   A. father's brother
   B. father
   C. sister
   D. mother's brother

5. Which is a good way of caring for household items? (1 mark)
   A. Leave a lamp near water
   B. Wash cups and plates after use
   C. Throw books on the floor
   D. Leave a knife within reach of small children

6. What does the Arabic word الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') mean? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Tuesday
   C. week
   D. Wednesday

7. Which day is al-jumuʿa? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Sunday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Saturday

8. How is the Arabic word الْخَمِيسُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. al-ahad
   B. al-khamiis
   C. amsi
   D. as-sabt

9. What does the Arabic word بَالُونٌ (baaluun) mean? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. balloon
   C. candle
   D. juice

10. What does the Arabic word مَاءٌ (maa') mean? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. sugar
   C. water
   D. chicken

11. What does the Arabic word يَدٌ (yad) mean? (1 mark)
   A. tooth
   B. mouth
   C. stomach
   D. hand

12. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you for listening.
   B. I like my house.
   C. In my house there is a kitchen.
   D. I am in Grade 4.

13. How do you read the syllable بِي? (1 mark)
   A. bi
   B. bii
   C. laa
   D. qaa

14. How do you read the syllable لِ? (1 mark)
   A. muu
   B. qaa
   C. ti
   D. li

15. Which letter has three dots above it? (1 mark)
   A. ب (baa)
   B. ث (thaa)
   C. ج (jiim)
   D. ت (taa)

16. Which Arabic word means "father"? (1 mark)
   A. أَبٌ
   B. عَمَّةٌ
   C. جَدَّةٌ
   D. أُخْتٌ

17. How do you read the syllable تُ? (1 mark)
   A. nii
   B. tu
   C. bu
   D. thaa

18. Which Arabic word means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. حَدِيقَةٌ
   B. بَيْتٌ
   C. سَاعَةٌ
   D. حَقِيبَةٌ

19. What does the word ghadan mean? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. today
   C. yesterday
   D. tomorrow

20. Which Arabic sentence means "Above the table there is a balloon." (1 mark)
   A. هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ
   B. الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ
   C. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ
   D. فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ

21. What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is a party.
   B. Above the table there is a balloon.
   C. On the table there is a cake.
   D. The friends are at the party.

22. How is the Arabic word مُفِيدٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. masaa'u l-khayr
   B. jadiid
   C. nahr
   D. mufiid

23. Which Arabic sentence means "Water is useful (good for you)." (1 mark)
   A. الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ
   B. الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ
   C. أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ
   D. السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ

24. Which Arabic word means "heart"? (1 mark)
   A. وَجْهٌ
   B. أُذُنٌ
   C. ظَهْرٌ
   D. قَلْبٌ

25. What can you do when you meet an unknown word in a text? (1 mark)
   A. Stop reading
   B. Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning
   C. Give up
   D. Skip the whole text

26. What does jism mean? (1 mark)
   A. heart
   B. hand
   C. head
   D. body

27. What does the Arabic sentence مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. And the rain is from the sky.
   B. We dance.
   C. The sun is in the sky.
   D. How beautiful the environment is!

28. Which Arabic word means "book"? (1 mark)
   A. سِكِّينٌ
   B. كِتَابٌ
   C. سَاعَةٌ
   D. حَقِيبَةٌ

29. What is the name of the Arabic letter ع? (1 mark)
   A. ʿayn
   B. kaaf
   C. Saad
   D. alif

30. What is the name of the Arabic letter ي? (1 mark)
   A. Saad
   B. yaa
   C. waaw
   D. zaay

31. What does the shadda over the last letter of umm tell the reader? (1 mark)
   A. Say the letter twice
   B. The letter is silent
   C. The vowel is long
   D. The word is finished

32. What does the Arabic word أَخٌ (akh) mean? (1 mark)
   A. father's sister
   B. son
   C. mother's brother
   D. brother

33. Which Arabic word means "friend"? (1 mark)
   A. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   B. تَفَضَّلْ
   C. مَبْرُوكٌ
   D. صَدِيقٌ

34. What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a gift.
   B. We dance.
   C. My mother cooks the food.
   D. I like the party.

35. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a gift.
   B. We dance.
   C. My mother cooks the food.
   D. I like the party.

36. Which sentence says 'I clean my teeth'? (1 mark)
   A. aghsilu wajhii
   B. unadhdhifu asnaanii
   C. aktubu bi-yadii
   D. raʾsii kabiir

37. What does the Arabic sentence رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I clean my teeth.
   B. My head is big.
   C. I wash my face.
   D. My hand is small.

38. Which Arabic word means "tooth"? (1 mark)
   A. وَجْهٌ
   B. أُذُنٌ
   C. سِنٌّ
   D. رَأْسٌ

39. Which Arabic word means "beautiful"? (1 mark)
   A. جَمِيلٌ
   B. رِيحٌ
   C. سَمَاءٌ
   D. حَارٌّ

40. What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is strong.
   B. This is rain.
   C. This is the sun.
   D. The sun is hot.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir. al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila. (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Write in Arabic sounds a question and an answer about bananas and give the meaning. (4 marks) (4 marks)

43. Translate into English: fii baytii matbakh (2 marks)

44. Write two Arabic sentences in sounds about a celebration and translate them. (4 marks) (4 marks)

45. Explain how the same Arabic word can look different but keep its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila (2 marks)

47. List four theme words about the home in Arabic (English letters), with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

48. Write five household items in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

49. Put these letters in order to make a day: ت ب س. Write the word and its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Describe how to make a food chart for the class wall. (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Rearrange the words to make a sentence and translate it: الْخَمِيسِ / يَوْمُ / الْيَوْمُ. (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Describe how to draw and label a household item. (4 marks) (4 marks)

53. Translate into English: al-jawwu ghaa'im (2 marks)

54. Translate into English: akhii yalʿabu (2 marks)

55. Translate into English: hal ʿindaka hafla? (2 marks)

56. Put these syllables in order to make a family word and give its meaning: khaa + lun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

57. Match these to their Arabic names: chair, bed, kitchen. Write the sounds. (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Give three rules for taking turns in a conversation. (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Describe how a group can stage a poem at an interclass festival. (4 marks) (4 marks)

60. Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub (2 marks)

61. Describe how to copy a family word neatly. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — أَنَا مِنْ كينيا
   أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

2. A — goodbye
   مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

3. C — sister
   أُخْتٌ (ukht) means sister.

4. B — father
   أَبٌ (ab) means father.

5. B — Wash cups and plates after use
   Cleaning items after use helps them to last and keeps the home safe.

6. D — Wednesday
   الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') means Wednesday.

7. A — Friday
   al-jumuʿa is Friday.

8. B — al-khamiis
   الْخَمِيسُ is read al-khamiis and means Thursday.

9. B — balloon
   بَالُونٌ (baaluun) means balloon.

10. C — water
   مَاءٌ (maa') means water.

11. D — hand
   يَدٌ (yad) means hand.

12. D — I am in Grade 4.
   أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ (anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ) means: I am in Grade 4.

13. B — bii
   بِي is read bii.

14. D — li
   لِ is read li.

15. B — ث (thaa)
   Thaa has three dots above. Baa has one dot below and taa has two dots above.

16. A — أَبٌ
   أَبٌ (ab) means father.

17. B — tu
   تُ is read tu.

18. A — حَدِيقَةٌ
   حَدِيقَةٌ (hadiiqa) means garden.

19. D — tomorrow
   ghadan means tomorrow. amsi means yesterday.

20. D — فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ
   فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

21. C — On the table there is a cake.
   عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka) means: On the table there is a cake.

22. D — mufiid
   مُفِيدٌ is read mufiid and means useful.

23. B — الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ
   الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

24. D — قَلْبٌ
   قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

25. B — Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning
   Clues around a word help to infer its meaning.

26. D — body
   jism means body.

27. D — How beautiful the environment is!
   مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ (maa ajmala l-bii'a) means: How beautiful the environment is!

28. B — كِتَابٌ
   كِتَابٌ (kitaab) means book.

29. A — ʿayn
   The letter ع is called ʿayn.

30. B — yaa
   The letter ي is called yaa.

31. A — Say the letter twice
   A shadda doubles the sound.

32. D — brother
   أَخٌ (akh) means brother.

33. D — صَدِيقٌ
   صَدِيقٌ (sadiiq) means friend.

34. A — I have a gift.
   عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

35. D — I like the party.
   أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ (anaa uhibbu l-hafla) means: I like the party.

36. B — unadhdhifu asnaanii
   unadhdhifu means I clean and asnaanii means my teeth.

37. B — My head is big.
   رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ (raʾsii kabiir) means: My head is big.

38. C — سِنٌّ
   سِنٌّ (sinn) means tooth.

39. A — جَمِيلٌ
   جَمِيلٌ (jamiil) means beautiful.

40. D — The sun is hot.
   الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ (ash-shamsu haarra) means: The sun is hot.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cat is under the bed. The lamp is above the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: hal tuhibbu l-mawz? naʿam, uhibbu l-mawz. Do you like bananas? Yes, I like bananas.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: In my house there is a kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example haadhihi hafla. This is a party. ʿindii hadiyya. I have a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each translation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: In different writing styles the letter shapes change a little, but the letters, sounds and meaning stay the same.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for shapes change and 1 mark for meaning stays the same.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: The lamp is above the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table), kursii (chair).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: سبت (sabt), Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Draw local foods, write the Arabic name under each picture, colour it and post it on the wall for review.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for drawing, 1 mark for labels and 1 mark for posting or review.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ. Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw the item, colour it, write its Arabic name under it from right to left, write the meaning and check the spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is cloudy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: My brother plays.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: khaa-lun (mother's brother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the meaning.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: chair is kursii, bed is sariir, kitchen is matbakh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen until the speaker finishes; do not speak at the same time; use polite words to interrupt; give others a chance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a group; share the lines and actions; stand facing the audience; say the poem together with actions; bow at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: On the table there is a cup.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say the word aloud; look at each letter and mark; write it once and compare with the model; correct and write it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.
